# Roles and Permissions

The owner and admin of a Razorpay account can [assign user roles from the Razorpay web Dashboard](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/payments/dashboard/account-settings/manage-team.md#invite-a-user). Based on the role assigned, when users log in to the mobile app, they will have varying access permissions to access features, as mentioned below.
